description:
Audit the contrast of the palette built from a brand color: which text and background pairs pass WCAG, which fail, and what to change. Returns a contrast matrix, the failures and recommendations.

To check one specific foreground and background pair, use a11y_validate (free, no key). audit_all_combinations checks every pair in the palette, not just the meaningful ones.

audit_all_combinations.description: Check every pair in the palette, not just the meaningful ones

color.description: Brand color in hex (e.g. #6366F1). The whole system is built from it.

colors.description: Additional brand colors in hex (up to 5 colors in total, including `color`).

preferences.description: Other design preferences, so tools called separately stay consistent with each other. Pass the same values to every tool.

color_scheme.description: How the palette is derived (default analogous)

name: pitch_audit_contrast
